column1: # Self-test cases for scripts/interop.sh, against the baseline fixture.
#   1  state   "ro" (the case does not change the device; servers are shared)
#              "rw" (the case gets a freshly started server)
#   2  exit    expected exit code of the client
#   3  summary expected outcome: ok, error code, exception code, function code
#              of the response and number of bits, registers or objects in it
#   4  needs   "-", or features the pairing must declare in print-capabilities,
#              A pairing that lacks one skips the case.
#   5  operation and its flags, as passed to "client"
#   6  id      stable scenario ID of results.json (case.<id>, agree.<id>): never
#              change it when the wording of the operation changes
# Every case runs for every client/server pairing. Besides matching the
# expectation, all pairings must produce the same result document.
# Baseline: coils 0..1999, discrete inputs 1000..2999, holding registers
# 0..255, input registers 65280..65535, unit identifier 1; server ID 42;
# file 1 with 200 records, file 2 with 4; FIFO queues at 1246 (2 values),
